positions.title: CEO, Cofounder
positions.description: - Built a data collection app and analytics dashboard that help non-profits collect data about homelessness.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: - I led a team that worked on the backend and supporting infrastructure for Dash Enterprise (a kubernetes native application that would dynamically spin up dash apps and supporting infrastructure like postgres or redis databases).

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Full stack engineer working in Angular (2 and 4), C# (.NET Core), and SQL Server. 
Developed a dynamic rules engine and multiple APIs. 
Spearheaded the completion of a project everyone had given up for dead. 
Introduced unit tests, integration tests, and load testing to the company. 
Removed major legal risk by challenging assumptions and re-architecting part of a project. 
Mentored others on good coding practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Scrum Master.
Standardized process for handling support requests across the five SDK teams. 
Standardized git workflow and build process (with a couple others). 
Designed and architected a major new feature (PDF comparison).
Individual contributor adding features and fixing bugs in our imaging SDKs.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: Individual contributor who worked on a team fixing bugs, adding features, and expanding test coverage of our imaging SDKs for C# and C++.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Support
positions.description: Assisted veteran software engineers in using Accusoft SDKs effectively by writing sample code, investigating/triaging reported bugs, and jumping on live calls to troubleshoot problems in the wild (using C#, C++, Java, VB .NET, VB6, NodeJS, and vanilla Javascript).
